description: Allow sandboxed processes to open URLs in the host browser. Disabling it also prevents in-sandbox OAuth logins that redirect to localhost.
Allow sandboxed agents to read the host clipboard for image paste (Ctrl+V).
Dial the cloud SSH gateway directly instead of through the proxy selected for CLI host egress.

Allow sandboxes to list SSH agent keys and sign, but not add, remove or lock keys. Disabling blocks new agent connections; existing connections remain active. After enabling, restart the daemon, then restart sandboxes that started with forwarding disabled.
